proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9201 *bājjara explicitly gives Punjabi bājrā, Hindi bājrā/bājṛā and Nepali bājuro “millet”. The survey bāyra/bāyarā forms preserve this distinctive grain family with local j/y development, and the deeper reconstruction remains uncertain. Reviewed comparator: kaithal bajra “millet” (f_mscok32yaorko). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.
